status.description: The wizard only offers modules with status "ready".

hidden.description: The module contributes no nav-rail item and no "/<id>" route — it wraps or extends the shell instead (auth: the sign-in gate, the user menu and /team). Its shell descriptor must carry the matching `hidden: true`.
hidden.$comment: Kept in the manifest, not only in the descriptor, because the wizard writes the agent handoff from manifests alone and would otherwise print a dead deep link.

selection.description: "opt-in" modules are offered in the picker but never auto-included by --yes (they need credentials the wizard cannot invent, e.g. a Supabase project).

items.description: A module id, the same shape as `id`: it is joined to content/modules/ to reach a directory.

requires.description: Module ids that must be co-installed (knowledge dependencies). "core" is implicit for every module and never listed.

items.description: A module id, the same shape as `id`: it is joined to content/modules/ to reach a directory.

recommends.description: Module ids the wizard suggests; the user can decline.

installAs.description: Directory name the skill is installed as, inside the agent's skills directory.

dir.description: One directory name inside the module, copied whole into the agent's skills directory. One segment, so it cannot reach out of the module.

app.description: UI contribution to the shell app (content/shell). Dev serving, port and app kind are the shell's — modules only declare env needs and their embeddable root.

name.description: What every reader of a .env accepts as a name. The wizard writes these into the app's .env one per line, and the file format has no escape.

default.description: Written as-is into the .env. A line break there would declare a variable rather than fill one.

optional.description: May stay empty; the wizard writes it as a commented-out line when it has no value.

resolve.description: Which wizard step supplies the value: the auth setup step (Supabase project), the Chatfuel workspace picker, or the admin-password step.

roots.description: Shell-relative embeddable roots, e.g. "src/modules/livechat". No dots in any segment, so a root cannot climb out of the shell it is resolved against.

entryComponent.description: The React component the embed renders. A JavaScript identifier, because it is written into generated source.

additionalProperties.description: A semver range or a dist-tag, and nothing else. The wizard joins name and version into one npm install argument and runs it, with install scripts, inside the user's own project, so a value carrying ":" or "/" — file:, link:, portal:, workspace:, npm:, git+ssh://, https://, or a bare user/repo — would name a source the manifest is not allowed to choose.

npmDependencies.description: Package names the embed adds to the host's package.json, mapped to version ranges.

playbook.description: A skill-relative markdown file. No dots outside the extension, so it cannot climb out of the skill directory.

permissions.description: Chatfuel role permissions the module needs; the wizard prints them verbatim in the agent handoff, so an empty one reads as a line about nothing.
